\section{Lattices}
A lattice is a free $\mathbb{Z}$-module of finite rank with a symmetric bilinear form.
Its dual is defined in Section~\ref{dual}.
\newpage
\section{Gram matrices}
For a basis $e_1, \dots, e_n$ the Gram matrix is $G = (b(e_i, e_j))_{i,j}$.
\newpage
\section{Dual lattices}\label{dual}
The dual lattice is $L^\vee = \{ x \in L \otimes \mathbb{Q} : b(x, L) \subseteq \mathbb{Z} \}$.
